purpose: Teach: 連勝/指紋/まっとう/集う/体裁/課し/フランチャイズ/振込み

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、本気で、絶対、連勝、絶対、続けていけ、社員、皆、本気で、絶対、頑張れ、絶対、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The industry is moving fast. I need everyone here to stay focused, keep pushing forward. This matters. Don't let up.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Clear enunciation. Direct eye contact. Each clause lands with quiet weight. No rush, but unmistakable intention beneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、指紋認証、絶対、新たに、絶対、導入いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We've successfully installed the new fingerprint authentication system. Thank you for your guidance.
lines.style: Respectful, precise delivery. Slight formal register. Steady pace. Pride in the accomplishment, tempered by deference. Brief pause before closing—acknowledgment, not obsequiousness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: まっとうな、本気で、絶対、経営、絶対、当社、貫いていく、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、社員、皆
lines.en: Good. Maintain that integrity in how we run this company. Protect our reputation. I'm counting on all of you.
lines.style: Firm conviction. The word 'integrity' lands with weight. Slower pace, almost deliberate. Quiet intensity—not raised volume, but steel underneath. Eyes on the room.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、集う場、絶対、月に、絶対、一回、設けてまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're establishing a monthly gathering space for the team. It'll help us stay connected.
lines.style: Respectful, matter-of-fact. The update delivered without flourish. Measured tempo. Genuine commitment in tone, not performance. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お得意様への、本気で、絶対、体裁、絶対、整えろ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、社員、皆
lines.en: And present ourselves well to our valued clients. They notice these things. Make sure we're ready. All of you.
lines.style: Composed, pointed. Slight emphasis on 'present ourselves'—not vain, but deliberate. Paced like instructions being given to someone trusted. The closing words carry accountability.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に、本気で、絶対、目標、絶対、課しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've set clear targets for the team. They know what excellence looks like now.
lines.style: Confirming, brief. Efficient delivery. A note of satisfaction—the job done properly. No elaboration needed. Professional respect in the brevity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: フランチャイズ展開、本気で、絶対、検討、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The franchise expansion—let's move forward on that. Study the options carefully. This is important.
lines.style: Deliberate, forward-focused. Slight uptick in energy on 'move forward.' Authoritative but not commanding—inviting strategic thought. Measured closing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様、本気で、絶対、振込み、絶対、確認いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. I've verified all payments from our key accounts. Everything is in order.
lines.style: Precise, confirmation-final. Quiet competence. Calm assurance. The last line of a checklist completed successfully. Professional closure—brief, reliable.
